title: Demo arm still never navigates vacancy-typed notifications while the real arm does
detail: The real arm pushes /vacancies/<vid> for Some("vacancy"), but the demo arm's catch-all still swallows vacancy clicks with no navigation. The hunk's comment claims behaviour parity ('the same behaviour the real arm now has'), which is only true for application type.
recommended_fix: Add a Some("vacancy"), Some(vid) -> modem.push("/vacancies/" <> vid, ...) branch to the demo arm, or drop the parity claim in the comment.

title: Rejected/auto-closed stepper rails lack md:justify-end that the pipeline rail gained
evidence:
-        "grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 w-full md:w-auto md:flex md:flex-wrap md:items-center md:gap-2",
+        "flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto w-full md:w-auto md:flex-wrap md:overflow-visible md:justify-end",
detail: view_pipeline's new class list includes md:justify-end, but the two sibling hunks for view_rejected and view_auto_closed use the identical new class list minus md:justify-end. Three visually parallel stop rails now align differently on desktop with no stated reason.
recommended_fix: Either add md:justify-end to the view_rejected and view_auto_closed containers, or add a comment explaining the intentional difference.

title: Unresolved application notification click is a silent no-op
detail: When the application isn't in the demo store or the currently loaded leaderboard, the click still marks the notification read and closes the dropdown but navigates nowhere and gives the landlord no feedback. The comment calls this graceful degradation, but the user sees a dead click.
recommended_fix: On None, surface a toast or navigate to the notifications/vacancy list fallback so the click has an observable outcome.

title: Test binds notifications then discards it with let _
detail: The test destructures notifications only to throw it away via let _ = notifications. Either assert something about the read row (the stated contract 'marks the row read' is never directly pinned) or bind with a discard pattern.
recommended_fix: Assert notifications contains n-1 with is_read == True, or destructure as #(_, unread) and drop the let _ line.

title: Real-arm resolver only consults the on-screen vacancy's leaderboard
detail: A real application notification clicked from any route other than that vacancy's detail page (e.g. the dashboard, where notifications are typically read) can never resolve, so in the live app the deep link only works while already viewing the owning vacancy. Comment acknowledges it, but the feature is effectively demo-only.
recommended_fix: Include vacancy id in the notification payload (entity_id or a sibling field) server-side, or fetch the owning vacancy on click instead of relying on loaded state.
